name: Error
when: Something failed and it is dealing with it

variants.name: Warning
variants.desc: A warning sign pops up: a jolt, then a determined look.

variants.name: Fixing
variants.desc: Gets a wrench on it, looking determined.

variants.name: Bandage
variants.desc: Plaster on, shakes it off and gets ready again.

variants.name: Glitch
variants.desc: Jitters with glitch bars and flashes of x eyes.

variants.name: Smoke
variants.desc: A puff of smoke and dazed x eyes, then shakes it off.

parts.t: <g class="eg eg-x" stroke="{{a.eye}}"><g transform="translate({{a.lex}} {{a.ley}})"><path class="gl" d="M-4 -4L4 4M4 -4L-4 4"></path></g><g transform="translate({{a.rex}} {{a.rey}})"><path class="gl" d="M-4 -4L4 4M4 -4L-4 4"></path></g></g>

<g class="att att-band" transform="translate({{a.bandx}} {{a.bandy}})"><g class="a bdg"><rect class="plaster" x="-9" y="-3" width="18" height="6" rx="3" transform="rotate(40)"></rect><rect class="plaster" x="-9" y="-3" width="18" height="6" rx="3" transform="rotate(-40)"></rect></g></g>

<g class="fx-warn" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 4)"><g class="a wrn"><path class="wtri" d="M0 -10L10 7H-10Z"></path><path class="wex" d="M0 -4V1.5"></path><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="4.2" r="1.3"></circle></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-wrench" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><g transform="translate(94 62)"><g class="a nt"><path class="nut" d="M-4 -6.9H4L8 0L4 6.9H-4L-8 0Z"></path><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle></g><g class="vb0 wr"><circle class="wrc" cx="0" cy="0" r="9.5" stroke-dasharray="52.2 7.5" stroke-dashoffset="48.5"></circle><path class="wrh" d="M-6.7 -6.7L-16 -16"></path></g></g></g>
<g class="fx-bump"><g transform="translate({{a.bkx}} {{a.bky}})"><path class="a bst gold" d="M0 -4.5L1.3 -1.3L4.5 0L1.3 1.3L0 4.5L-1.3 1.3L-4.5 0L-1.3 -1.3Z"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-slices" transform="translate(0 {{a.mo}})"><rect class="a slc" x="18" y="34" width="44" height="4" fill="#F27863"></rect><rect class="a slc" x="38" y="58" width="44" height="3" fill="#00BDCF"></rect></g>

<g class="fx-smoke2" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><circle class="a sm2 smoke" cx="46" cy="14" r="4.5"></circle><circle class="a sm2 smoke" cx="54" cy="12" r="4"></circle><circle class="a sm2 smoke" cx="50" cy="10" r="5"></circle></g>
